notes: VAT 18% from 1 Jan 2024 on locally made jewellery and imported gold coins/bars (Customs Tariff 2026 Ch.71 shows 18% VAT + 2.5% SSCL for HS 7108/7113/7106). A single gold import-duty % could not be reliably read from the tariff PDF columns, so importDutyPct is null. Making 5-15% by craftsmanship (typical shown as range midpoint). No dealer bar-by-size sell list or stated buyback/used % found.
